summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun binary
details: The package advertises itself as a CSS/Tailwind styles library but ships a `preinstall` lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that at npm install time downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13) into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation, single-letter/hex identifiers, `with` statements) with no source correspondence and no documentation of its purpose. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with `_0x` hex identifiers and indirection wrappers around `execFileSync`. Fetching an alternate JS runtime at install time and using it to execute a bundled opaque payload evades Node-based scanners and grants the payload full host access at install, with no relationship to the package's stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
